in_sanskrit.name: Allu
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Rudra's banner
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Allu एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Allu is derived from the Sanskrit word "Allah" or "Aghora", which is a name of Lord Shiva. This name represents Rudra's banner and is often used for boys in Hindu tradition.

in_tamil.name: Allu

This name represents Rudra's banner and is often used for boys in Hindu tradition.
